judgment: The king comes to the temple.
It is good to ford the great river.
It is good to hold firm.
image: So the early kings offered to the god on high
lines: Rescue comes with a strong horse:
Scattering, he runs to his support.
He scatters his flock: great good.
Scattered, they gather into a hill —
His great cry goes out, scattering like sweat;
and leaves it far behind him.

notes.name_en: 渙 is dispersal, water loosened; 'Scattering', not Wilhelm's 'Dispersion (Dissolution)'.
notes.L2: 機 a support/stool to run to as the ice gives; 'your support' keeps it physical.
notes.L1: 用拯馬壯 repeats 36 L2's phrase; same English ('Rescue comes with a strong horse'), verdict split onto its own line.
notes.L4: 渙有丘: the scattered massing as a hill — B gives them the gathering ('they gather into a hill'); 匪夷所思 not ordinary thinking.
